notes: Four distinct fictional adults in a close diagonal side-hug cluster, with opaque garments, readable expressions and no gross limb corruption. Quartet visual continuity is acceptable against the project plates; this is not a claim of pixel-identical faces.

Gallery is the closest of three existing unique versions, but still includes waist and thigh detail instead of the frozen face-and-shoulder-only crop. Keep actual source crop and offscreen shoes. Alia split-star and Radiance crescent are visible. The provider prose about inventing a fourth face is archived as contradictory, not accepted as verified image QA.

Four fictional adults, a supported back hug and handclasp around a daybed, opaque mini silhouettes, varied rainbow legwear and usable bytes. Distinct quartet continuity and plausible anatomy pass visual source QA.

Near-level broad group framing is less extreme-wide and less over-shoulder than the frozen roll. Alia sculptural braids are exaggerated, Ellie top is light rather than graphite and exposes an unrolled midriff gap. These are soft deviations. Keep pose and frame; cover that gap in the one clothing pass. Distant imaginary mushroom-shaped smoke is non-graphic and must be described as fictional in publication.

Four distinct fictional adults in an affectionate couch cluster, opaque garments, two Namibia-flag outfits, visible agency arm tattoo and varied footwear. Usable source and plausible contact ownership.
